use_case_summary:
Primary workload: outbound SDR chat assistant that runs in the rep UI. Must support: streaming responses (token-by-token), tool calling for: 1) push/pull to Salesforce, 2) send email drafts via Gmail API, 3) create/update Google Calendar events.
Latency SLOs: first token within 120-200ms for interactive feel; end-to-end action (tool call + confirmation) <500ms for most flows.
Scale: target 30-75 concurrent active agents during peak; average session length ~45-90s. Cost sensitivity: care about per-agent tail costs; want batching/caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
Failover requirements: graceful fallback to smaller model variant for capacity and regional routing for EU customers.
poc_plan:
Week 1: Hosted API onboarding + sample integration (streaming + single tool call).
Week 2: Run synthetic load (50 concurrent agents) capture p95/p99 latency, error modes, partial token streaming behavior.
Week 3: Integrate Salesforce & Gmail actions end-to-end; run sign-off flows.
Deliverables: latency report, token cost estimate, suggested Dedicated sizing for expected sustained load, integration checklist for security.
Success criteria: p95 stream latency <250ms and tool-call action latency <600ms; integration passes basic SRA checks.
